definitions.explanation: A fabric divider hung at shop entrances, often bearing the shop name or logo.
A business's established reputation and brand value.

examples.english: It's not easy to pass on the reputation built by the founder to the next generation.

notes:
{暖簾|のれん} is a traditional split fabric curtain hung at shop entrances in Japan.

SENSE 1 - PHYSICAL CURTAIN:
- {暖簾|のれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くぐる→潜る：10314_kuguru⟧: to pass through (enter a shop)
- {暖簾|のれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|お}ろす→下ろす：02029_orosu⟧: to put up the noren (open shop)
- {暖簾|のれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to take down the noren (close shop)

SENSE 2 - REPUTATION/GOODWILL:
- {暖簾|のれん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: to protect the reputation
- {暖簾|のれん}⟦{分|わ}け→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: branch shop (traditional franchising)
- {暖簾|のれん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to damage one's reputation

IDIOM:
{暖簾|のれん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦{押|お}し→押す：02854_osu⟧: wasted effort (lit. pushing against a curtain = no resistance, pointless)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Noren display the shop name/logo and signal the business is open. They're iconic in traditional shopping districts.
